title: Silent Hill f Costs You $1.78 an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
Silent Hill f is $19.59 on Steam this week (72% off $69.99) and the main story takes about 11 hours (HowLongToBeat): $1.78 an hour. At full price it was $6.36 an hour, more than a $6-an-hour movie ticket. Our own math.
Which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price, 27 Nov), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: Send this to the friend with 300 hours in Silent Hill f: at full price it cost more per hour than a movie. Today, $1.78.
